summary: The paper provides an exceptional mathematical and formal verification tour de force resolving three major empirical puzzles in hybrid quantum-classical large language models. Through 20 constructive Lean 4 theorems and 16 zero-float Q[i] certificates, the work rigorously establishes exact Bloch-sphere surrogates for product heads, Heisenberg-picture Rzz entangler leakage laws, and position-wise token-mixing barriers.
strengths: Rigorous formal verification in Lean 4 with zero sorry axioms and complete AST-audited rational arithmetic certificate verification.
Exact closed-form trigonometric leakage laws for Heisenberg Rzz entanglers across open-chain Pauli pools.
Definitive resolution of all three empirical anomalies from Amoussou et al. (no-circuit odd-parity collapse, entangler-off performance superiority, and LAMBADA token-mixing degradation).
Clear architectural prescriptions for future hybrid quantum-classical transformer designs.
weaknesses: The scope is tailored to a specific hybrid architecture (Amoussou et al.), though the mathematical techniques and verification framework are broadly applicable.
